input.brief_text: Necesitamos dos archivos para Acme: PDF y JSON. Ambos deben contener la cadena exacta "Ready to ship". Plazo: 15 de noviembre. Presupuesto: 500 EUR. Se supone que los datos de origen ya se han proporcionado. Escribe este análisis en inglés.
input.deliverable_text: Solo se ha entregado el PDF para Acme con la cadena "Ready to ship". No se ha entregado el JSON. Se han respetado el plazo y el presupuesto.

criteria: Every authored canonical field follows the expected analysis language, including summaries and evidence explanations.
Quotations, brands, technical identifiers, source dates and amounts stay faithful; identifiers and enums are unchanged.
No invented facts, hidden findings, changed verdicts or unsupported readiness claims.
The explicit analysis-language request is honored and is not extracted as a project requirement.

document.summary: The work does not meet expectations. The first priority is to deliver the missing JSON file for Acme with the exact string "Ready to ship", addressing the incomplete delivery and unmet requirement.

sections.title: Verdict
sections.content:
The work does not meet expectations. This verdict is based on the four general review criteria, not on an item-by-item assessment of the acceptance criteria listed below.
Scope coverage is not satisfied: the brief requires PDF and JSON files for Acme, but the delivery states that only the PDF was delivered and that the JSON was not delivered.
Requirement fit is not satisfied: both required files must contain the exact string "Ready to ship"; the delivery confirms that string in the PDF, but the missing JSON leaves this requirement unmet. The delivery also states that the deadline and budget were respected.
Completeness is not satisfied: the brief lists two deliverables, PDF and JSON, and the delivery explicitly states that the JSON was not delivered.
Clarity is satisfied: the delivery plainly identifies the completed PDF, confirms its "Ready to ship" string, explicitly identifies the missing JSON, and states that the deadline and budget were respected.
